about_the_game:
Summary 

Rain's Golf is a chaotic multiplayer golf game where up to 4 players compete in wild, strategic matches using cards! Master tricky maps, play your cards wisely, and outsmart your friends to claim victory.

Each round, before the active player takes their shot, the other players secretly cast their cards. Once the golfer decides it’s time to swing, the chaos begins - every hidden card is revealed at once! This means card-casters must predict the golfer’s strategy and shot direction, all while racing against the clock.

Team up with up to 3 friends!

Join your friends or make your lobby public and compete with strangers!  

Choose your color!

Each player get to choose their color at the beginning of the game - pick one that suits you best.

Explore interesting maps!

Each map has it's own unique obstacles and environment together with many different paths to take while fighting for victory  

Explore crazy cards!

Explore new cards by playing and track your progress in the card album. Cards are chaotic - ranging from simple brick walls to meteorites, landmines or even piece of ham!

short_description: A multiplayer golf game with a chaotic twist! Each round, opponents draw random cards to sabotage the current player’s shot - from explosive traps to wild obstacles. With a constantly expanding deck of cards, no two matches are ever the same. Outsmart, obstruct, and outplay your friends to win!
